_comment: Source of truth for flavor normalization. Loaded by processor.py at startup.
approved_flavors: allow-list. A flavor matching an entry (exact, fuzzy, word-order
or similarity >= SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD) is kept/normalized to that spelling.
aliases: explicit variant -> canonical mapping, applied BEFORE all other matching.
Needed because every locale words the same product differently ('fruits des bois',
'gozdni sadezi', 'berries') and the AI translates 1:1 as instructed. Fuzzy matching
cannot bridge these (e.g. 'Pistachio-Forest Fruits' scores 0.65 against
'Pistachio-Berries'). Keys match case-, hyphen-, ampersand- and whitespace-insensitively.
Changing this file invalidates the per-country cache (_flavors_hash), so new rules
take effect on the next run without --force.
